title: test_geocode_endpoint_with_valid_and_invalid_queries
description: Verify GET /api/geocode returns 200 with location suggestions and coordinates for valid queries, and returns 400 or 200 with no results for invalid queries, ensuring proper validation and user feedback.

title: test_analyze_endpoint_with_various_input_scenarios
description: Verify POST /api/analyze returns 200 with ranked route candidates and heat statistics for valid supported coordinates, returns 400 or 422 with controlled errors for unsupported or invalid coordinates, and handles route-not-found or analysis-limit errors gracefully with appropriate status codes and messages.

title: test_health_endpoint_service_availability
description: Verify GET /api/health returns 200 with healthy status when the service is running normally, and returns non-200 or unhealthy payload when the service is degraded, allowing frontend or monitoring systems to detect service availability.
